title: Writing · noun
subtitle: 「寫作／書面作品／文字內容／散文／文案」，究竟是哪一種 writing？
description: 「寫作／書面作品／文字內容／散文／文案」，究竟是哪一種 writing？

words.meaning: 書面作品；書面作業；寫作成果
words.note: 使用者提供。written work 是 writing 最廣而自然的改寫之一，指以文字完成的作品、作業或成果。它適合 schoolwork, coursework, professional drafts, creative work 等，但不特別限定文體。
words.example: Students submit a piece of written work at the end of each unit.

exercises.original: The teacher returned our writing with comments in the margins.
exercises.zh: 老師把我們的書面作業發還，頁邊附有評語。
exercises.upgrade: written work · 書面作品；書面作業；寫作成果

options.explanation: teacher feedback + returned material identifies student work submitted for assessment.
常指學校、考試或語言學習中的一篇結構化作文。 本題的決定性線索是 a submitted piece of student work；這裡需要的是「完成或提交的書面作品」。因此 composition 雖與 writing 有關，但作品身份、文字載體、文體、資料用途或商業文案功能並不最吻合。
指頁面、螢幕或文件上呈現的文字內容本身。 本題的決定性線索是 a submitted piece of student work；這裡需要的是「完成或提交的書面作品」。因此 text 雖與 writing 有關，但作品身份、文字載體、文體、資料用途或商業文案功能並不最吻合。

words.note: 使用者提供。composition 常指為學校、考試或語言學習而寫的文章，也可較正式地指一篇精心組織的文字作品。它比 written work 更容易帶『一篇完整文章』與結構安排的意味。
words.example: The students wrote a short composition about their hometown.

words.note: prose 指普通句子與段落構成的文字，與 poetry/verse 相對；也可評價某作者的文風。它不是所有 writing 的通用替代，必須有非詩體或文體語境。

falseSynonyms.zh: written work 強調完成／提交的作品；writing 還可表示文字內容、文體或寫作活動。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The teacher assessed our written work. Her writing is clear and concise.

falseSynonyms.zh: composition 常指一篇結構完整的作文，尤其在學校／考試語境；不是任何文字內容都叫 composition。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Write a composition about your hometown. The label contains very small text.

falseSynonyms.zh: text 強調可見的文字內容；writing 也可指作品或文體。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The text on the screen is blurred. Her writing won an award.

falseSynonyms.zh: prose 只處理非詩體連續文字或作者文風；詩歌、標籤文字、表格文字都不一定是 prose。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON His prose is elegant. The text on the label is tiny.

falseSynonyms.zh: copy 是廣告、出版、網站等專業語域中的文案；學生作文或一般筆記通常不用 copy。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The agency revised the advert copy. The student submitted her composition.

falseSynonyms.zh: handwriting 指字跡／手寫字形；writing 的產品義則是內容本身。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON His handwriting is difficult to read. His writing is thoughtful and well organised.

falseSynonyms.zh: literature 是文學作品的集合／領域；一般報告、網站文案、課堂作業不等於 literature。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She studies English literature. The report contains clear writing.

falseSynonyms.zh: authoring 偏創作／製作內容的行為或過程；本課的 writing 主要處理寫成的成果。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The software supports content authoring. The written work was submitted yesterday.
